key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 48, 72)
AUD smashed on growth scare, amplifying pressure on export-oriented sectors (Headline 58)
Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway, hitting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX directly (Headline 54)
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path (Headline 70)
Mortgage rates rose for second straight day; housing prices crashing while first-home buyers surge (Headlines 35, 61)
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-cut strategy faces execution risk (Headline 37)
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy fears; Santos preservation noted (Headlines 52, 73)
Woolworths.WSW breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, raising consumer trust concerns (Headline 60)
Mining cap raises accelerating via Canaccord, signalling cash stress in junior sector (Headline 49)
Premium office REITs outperforming as owners rethink workplace strategy (Headlines 1, 3)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore bloodletting underway; oil surge benefits energy names but broad commodity stress. Junior miners raising capital under duress. Gold underperforming ('Gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack a safe-haven bid. Junior miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) volatile. Battery tech (Critical Resources) a relative bright spot.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure valuations. ANZ.AX post-restructuring execution risk. Superannuation system under political scrutiny. Mortgage rates climbing.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression risk if RBA pauses. Super fund flows (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) under political pressure. Rising mortgage rates support NIM but hurt credit growth.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australia softens gas supply rules easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic. Fuel prices rising 30c.
sectors.implications: Santos.STO, Woodside.WDS benefit from firmer gas/oil pricing. Rising fuel costs (Headline 46) squeeze consumer and transport margins. LNG export flexibility a positive for Asian demand.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths.WSW breached its own price freeze on four staples. Australian businesses 'fear for their future'. Flight cancellations (1 in 3 days) disrupt consumer travel.
sectors.implications: WSW, COG.AX face margin and trust pressure. Rising fuel and input costs compress retail margins. Consumer sentiment deteriorating.

sectors.trend: Divergent. Premium offices pulling ahead as owners rethink workplaces; but office expenses outgrew revenue since 2021. Housing prices crashing; auction market flat. NZ correction continuing.
sectors.implications: Premium office REITs (VCG.AX, ICOL.AX) may see selective upside. Residential REITs and builders (WBC.AX exposure) under pressure. First-home buyer surge could support volume but not prices.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. NDIS cuts raise policy risk for health providers. Global pharma (NVO, MRK, TEVA) active. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX relatively insulated from domestic policy noise. NDIS cuts (Headline 10) a watch item for allied health. ASX tech small-caps volatile but showing relative strength.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX selloff ($90bn wipeout)
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and pressuring domestic consumption
Iron ore downturn vs oil surge creating sector rotation within materials
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
Housing correction accelerating; first-home buyer surge may not offset price falls
Mining sector cash stress: cap raises and junior equity dilution accelerating
Consumer trust erosion: WSW price freeze breach, business confidence low
Energy policy shift: gas supply rule relaxation supports Asian LNG demand
Superannuation under political attack, threatening long-term fund flows
Geopolitical: Chinese Arctic shipping route signals trade pattern shifts

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce net gearing; increase cash allocation; favour dividend-paying large caps over growth names
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or energy exposure
Hedge AUD exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor RBA commentary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy uncertainty (rental inflation vs growth)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid over-concentration in rate-sensitive REITs and property builders; monitor RBA minutes
Avoid junior miners with imminent cap raises; favour cash-flow-positive producers
Underweight WSW, COG.AX; favour value-oriented consumer names
Monitor political rhetoric; diversify super fund exposure; favour large diversified funds

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy (Santos, Woodside) on oil surge and gas policy tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australia softens gas rules easing Asian demand fears; fuel price rise supports upstream margins
Premium offices pulling ahead as owners rethink workplaces; selective demand in CBD Grade A stock
ASX runners of the week showing relative strength in risk-off environment; battery tech (Critical Resources) holding firm

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare (CSL, SGH) as global pharma activity continues
opportunities.rationale: NVO, MRK, TEVA active globally; CSL.AX insulated from domestic NDIS policy noise; defensive in volatile tape

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; gold underperforming; junior miners diluting via cap raises

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds; hedge AUD
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; rising yields make short bonds attractive; $90bn ASX wipeout signals further downside risk
WSW price freeze breach erodes trust; business confidence low; fuel costs rising 30c; flight cancellations disrupt travel
Housing prices crashing; no auction bounce; NZ correction continuing; RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend weakness as rate fears, oil-driven yield spike, and AUD weakness persist. Miners and banks remain under pressure. RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare limits policy flexibility. Expect volatile, choppy trading with further downside risk to ^AXJO.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for first-home buyers and selective REITs. Energy policy reform supports Santos/Woodside. Superannuation system, while under political attack, remains structurally sound. Iron ore cycle likely to stabilise. Key variable is RBA's ability to navigate the inflation-growth trade-off.
